name: Cometary-Crucible
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.
The deck plates hum with distant thunder that never resolves into an actual front. Sleep comes hard at first; later, it comes too easily.
Trade at the research outpost changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants deal fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
There is money in helium-3 here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
